description:
Dune: Part Three hits theaters December 18, 2026 — and it's the epic conclusion to Denis Villeneuve's trilogy. In this video, we break down everything you need to know: the story (based on Frank Herbert's Dune Messiah), the returning cast, and the new faces joining the world of Arrakis.

Timothée Chalamet returns as Paul Atreides, alongside Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem, and Josh Brolin — plus newcomers Robert Pattinson and Anya Taylor-Joy. Filmed in Budapest and Abu Dhabi, releasing in IMAX.
